note: MATRIYA has THREE first-class knowledge sources with DIFFERENT authority domains, running in PARALLEL — none blocks the others. Document Knowledge (what is written), Experimental Knowledge (what is measured), Operational Knowledge (how Fresco actually works). The third cannot be extracted from documents — it is undocumented organizational knowledge made explicit via interview.

streams.label: Document Knowledge — what is written
streams.gates: blocks DOCUMENT fan-out (Gate E / extraction quality) until Gold Standard clears

streams.label: Experimental Knowledge — what is measured
streams.authority_domain: empirical results — boundaries derived from measurement

streams.label: Operational Knowledge — how Fresco actually works
streams.authority_domain: undocumented organizational engineering model (NOT in documents)
streams.gates: does NOT depend on Rachel; validated directly by David; proceeds in parallel
streams.intake_mode: one question at a time (Question → Discussion → Model Update → Next) — see expert_interview_queue_v1.json

principle: Three first-class sources, three authority domains, run in parallel — never serialized. Document = how docs are read (Rachel). Experimental = what was measured (lab). Operational = how Fresco works (David); the unique asset, since it cannot be extracted from documents.
